notes.title: Figment: Creed Valley - Coming Fall 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l0uSPFQimgiKaFPItj/giphy.gif[/img]

Hey everyone! 

As you might have heard, we announced a new standalone game which will be a self-contained story of Figment last Friday. If you've enjoyed our surreal universes and whimsical humor, you'll surely be interested in this second opus.  

[h1]Enough of the chit-chat, let's get to the good stuff 
[/h1]

[b]The Jester[/b], unlike the other nightmares in the Figment universe, is part of The Mind. He once lived in a house in Creed Valley like the other voices, and was kept under control by a more responsible life style. However, due to his impulsive nature and disregard for the consequences, he has broken the [b]Moral Compass[/b] and leads a quest of rebellion.

The Mind is living in a state of internal conflict. As you venture deeper into the surreal and hand-painted world of [b]Creed Valley[/b], you will be able to collect [b]remembranes[/b]. These fragments of memories will allow you to peer into what events are troubling the subconscious. 

[h1]Creed Valley introduces:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A fresh chapter of Figment with its own self-contained story
[*] New singing nightmares with their own original songs and themes
[*] Discover two sides of the same world with a unique state-changing mechanic
[*] Whimsical narrative and art style
[*] Unravel mysteries as you venture into the depths of The Mind 
[/list]
The residents of the city are awaiting your visit. Creed Valley is where The Mind’s [b]beliefs and ideals are formed[/b]. You’ll talk with opinions, and some of their conversations might change whether you are in the[b] Open-minded [/b]or [b]Closed-minded[/b] state.

New mischievous spirits have arrived with [b]original songs[/b], try not to root for the wrong team while facing them. We’ve recently released the [b]theme song[/b] for Creed Valley, give it a listen and hold on to your feels. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-mqzYAkvMEo

Dusty has honed his skills in the first opus, and is readier than ever to face a new wave of enemies and challenges. Use wisely the[b] tools[/b] at your disposal and switch between mindsets to navigate through the recesses of The Mind.

Check out the Store page for more information!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085220/Figment_Creed_Valley/?beta=0

notes.title: Figment, a new game from Bedtime Digital Games is now available!!
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/493540/Figment/] Figment [/url] is now available on Steam, for Pc, Mac and Linux. 


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6405088/d028bd2c0c7f47064b16d75af9003f727217de06.png[/img]

Figment is a musical action-adventure set in the recesses of the human mind... 

This mind has been quiet and calm for many years. But something has changed. New thoughts have started to emerge - taking the shape of nightmarish creatures who spread fear wherever they go. The only hope is for the grumpy Dusty, the mind's former voice of courage, to get back to his old self and help the mind to face its fears.

Join Dusty and his ever-optimistic friend, Piper, on an adventure through the different sides of the mind, solving puzzles to set things straight, beating back the nightmares and seeking to restore the courage that's been lost.

Learn more on  [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/493540/Figment/] Figment's Steam page  [/url]

Also We have updated Back to Bed to now support Korean ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Back to Bed 1.1 is now live!
notes.notes:
You now have the option to play Back to Bed in 9 different languages (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese). To do so, simply select the language of your choice in the options menu. The GUI has been overhauled to improve performance and support for different resolutions. By request, keyboard bindings for fast forward and zooming has been added ([url=http://bedtimedigitalgames.dk/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/Back-to-Bed-Controls.pdf]click here[/url] for additional information).

Whether you already own Back to Bed or are getting it now, we hope you will enjoy playing in the language of your choice.

[b]Happy holidays![/b]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
[*]Added multi-language support
[*]Optimized GUI and made minor layout changes
[*]Minor bug fixes
[/list]
